text: In 1996, the family of a Maryland murder victim sued the publisher of Hit Man: A Technical Manual for Independent Contractors in U.S. District Court. A federal district court judge dismissed the suit on First Amendment grounds, but the Fourth Circuit reversed, holding that the book's content was criminal aiding and abetting and was not entitled to First Amendment protection. In 2001, victims of an attempted contract murder sued the publisher in an Oregon federal court for aiding and abetting and conspiracy to commit murder, and the court allowed the claims to go forward.
meta_description: Hit Man: A Technical Manual for Independent Contractors: its publisher was sued in 1996 and 2001; the Fourth Circuit denied First Amendment protection.
